name: Simple Profile And Roleplay Kit
description: SPARK is an RP module that allows you to create character profiles for roleplaying, advertise your profiles and RP status to others, roll dice, and view other player's RP profiles.

account.details: Required in order to attach your roleplay profiles to your account to prevent impersonation.

characters.details: Required in order to verify that your roleplay profile belongs to the current character on your account.
